title: uor-agent/context/1
description: The input of one turn: everything an answer is made from. Stored in the private namespace under its BLAKE3 kappa label (uor-addr, JCS + NFC), and forgotten with its author.

kernel.description: The agent's own holo, by the BLAKE3 label of its bytes, the model identity it carries, and the commit whose signed build it is (null only when the operator turned the provenance check off).

community.description: The community pin: the signed community holo by its BLAKE3 label, and the newest commit its verified provenance names.

surface.description: Discord, or a client of the agent's own MCP server, or a visitor to the website; off Discord only public items are served (decision 17).

register.description: On the website, an answer written to be heard. Absent for one written to be read.

history.description: The earlier answers this question builds on, by label, each admitted by the kernel: on Discord a reply to the agent, as the same author's, in the same channel, and recent (decision 16); on the website the answers a visitor presented by their keys, each still read back by its key and among the newest three (decision 31).

retrieval.description: The score band the kernel was told, and every item retrieval offered, before the kernel admitted any as a citation.

decision.description: The community decision asked, or null when no retrieved source is a community decision app.

inputs.description: Read from the question by the language model: interpretation, not fact.

answer.description: The community holo's answer; null when inputs were missing and it was not asked.
